PPU UG Sem-V Exam Form — LAST DATE TODAY, 22 November 2026! Late fee ke saath form aaj hi bharen.

Patliputra University (PPU) ne UG Sem-V (Session 2024-28) ka exam form late fee ke saath sirf aaj, 22 November 2026 ko khola hai. Official notice dated 21 November 2026 (Ref. PPU/Con./Exam-962/26).

Fee: Exam fee Rs. 600 + late fee Rs. 100 = Rs. 700 (online payment).
Eligibility: Sem-IV result me 68 credits hone chahiye.
Portal: ppuonline.in — form bharein, fee pay karein aur receipt print karke surakshit rakhen.

Official notice: https://ppup.ac.in/download//notice-2026/ug%20exam%20frm%20extension%20.pdf
